atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: defines design tokens (colors, fonts, spacing, breakpoints…) that generate utilities and CSS variables. Use `@theme inline` when the values reference variables that change per theme (e.g. light/dark).

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS: inlines existing utility classes into a custom CSS rule.

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: defines a custom utility class.

atDirectives.name: @variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: applies a variant (hover, focus, responsive…) to a custom rule.

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: registers a new custom variant.

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: explicitly registers additional source files or directories to scan for class names.

references.name: Tailwind CSS — Detecting classes in source files

atDirectives.name: @plugin
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: loads a legacy JavaScript plugin.

atDirectives.name: @config
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: loads a legacy JavaScript config file.

atDirectives.name: @reference
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: imports theme variables, custom utilities and custom variants from another stylesheet without duplicating its CSS (useful in CSS Modules and Vue/Svelte style blocks).
